channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rick Pitino | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rick Pitino from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jermaine O'Neal on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Speaking on the Str8 to Da League podcast, JermaineO'Neal shared that Kentucky was his top choice coming out of high school and that Pitino had heavily recruited him, making multiple in-home visits with O'Neal and his family.

“I was going to go to Kentucky. Shout out to Rick Pitino, man. Like he recruited me, and this was like the realest thing, man. My mother loved him, man. She loved him,”

Jermaine O'Neal on Rick Pitino, Jul 13, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Jermaine O'Neal on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Jermaine O'Neal:

“Rick Pitino was my guy. Shout out to Rick Pitino, man. He recruited me himself. Sometimes it’s just the assistant coaches—but he came every time to the house. He sat in my house and told my mother: 'Look, I’ve seen everything your son went through. I’ve got relationships in the NBA. They say he’s projected between 10th and 17th.' Then he said:'We’re going to be good with you—and we’ll be good without you. We’d love to have you. But knowing what I know: Go pro.'”

Jermaine O'Neal on Rick Pitino, May 30, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Rick Pitino
item.description:
KC Johnson:Donovan:

“I think I played for maybe the greatest player development coach in the world in Rick Pitino.”

Billy Donovan on Rick Pitino, Sep 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Rick Pitino
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Blake Griffin's injury:

“It's like when Rick Pitino said, 'Larry Bird isn't walking through that door.' ... Blake Griffin isn't walking through that door.”

Dwane Casey on Blake Griffin, Rick Pitino, Jan 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Rick Pitino
item.description:
“It’s great to see Nick again, he was always a great passer and he was coached this season by Rick Pitino, who was also my coach”

Billy Donovan on Rick Pitino, Aug 18, 2019. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Brett Brown on Rick Pitino
item.description:
“When I played for Rick Pitino at Boston University, he would literally tape bricks to your hands and you have to go elbow to elbow doing defensive slides and you had to get 20 in a minute,”

Brett Brown on Rick Pitino, Dec 7, 2018. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino:

“I’m not surprised. He’s put in his time, he’s had fun with it. He’s done the things he needed to do. He’ll always be a legend in my book and he can always coach me if he don’t want to coach any more. I’m happy for him in his retirement.”

Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino, Sep 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Chinanu Onuaku on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Chinanu Onuaku on Rick Pitino:

“He's one of the main reasons I went (to @CardinalMBB). I love that man. He taught me how to be a man.”

Chinanu Onuaku on Rick Pitino, Sep 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino:

“He's a great coach, a guy that I respect and everything. So it just sucks, the news.”

Terry Rozier on Rick Pitino, Sep 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Montrezl Harrell on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Montrezl Harrell on Rick Pitino:

“Even when you’re not wearing your Louisville jersey, he’s still coaching you from a distance. It’s great.”

Montrezl Harrell on Rick Pitino, Jun 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Walter McCarty on Rick Pitino
item.description:
“Working for Rick Pitino taught me a lot. It really prepared me for how to prepare for opponents, how to scout games, how to teach and develop players, and how to speak and communicate with players, as well,”

Walter McCarty on Rick Pitino, Aug 23, 2013. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Earl Clark on Rick Pitino
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Earl Clark on Rick Pitino's all-white suits (assets.sbnation.com/assets/77626/p…):

“It was like he'd be all swagged out w/ The Godfather theme music on”

Earl Clark on Rick Pitino, Jan 20, 2013. Source: Twitter @mcten.
